comment: The HMIS is positioned as a shared population-level reporting component, but the term is often used for the broader set of people, processes, policies, data, and systems supporting health management information. Treating HMIS solely as an application component may be misleading.

anchor.note: p.71 l.Lines 697-701 read as the printed page; section 3.5.3.2 agrees

public.text: The HMIS is positioned as a shared population-level reporting component, but the term is often used for the broader set of people, processes, policies, data, and systems supporting health management information. Treating HMIS solely as an application component may be misleading.
public.suggestedRevision: Use a more precise component name such as Aggregate Health Information and Indicator Service, or explain that the application component represents only the shared digital services within the wider HMIS.
